description: This file defines server load function, actions for CRUD operations on opportunities, line items management, and invoice creation in a SaaS CRM frontend project using SvelteKit. It interacts with a Django REST API backend, handling data fetching, creation, updating, deletion, and complex data transformation for opportunities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads opportunities data, filters, options, and statistics for the opportunities list page, fetching from backend API and processing responses.

methods.name: parseJsonArray
methods.description: Utility function to parse JSON arrays from form data inputs.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new opportunity via API, processing form data inputs.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing opportunity via API, selectively including fields from form data.

methods.name: actions.updateStage
methods.description: Handles updating only the stage of an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.addLineItem
methods.description: Adds a line item (product) to an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.updateLineItem
methods.description: Updates an existing line item on an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.deleteLineItem
methods.description: Removes a line item from an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.createInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice from an opportunity.
